thread:
maya: Heads up — running reconciliation this morning found ~87 invoices where Stripe shows a promo discount but NetSuite invoices are full amount. Noticed an uptick around the pricing experiment. tagging @anita and @sam_engineer
kevin: Can you confirm promo slug/experiment id? how big is the exposure?
anita: Sampled 20 rows: all belong to cohort SPRING-RUN2-15. Stripe invoice.lines include a negative line with type="discount" and promotion_code=SPRING-RUN2-15. NetSuite shows no corresponding credit line.
sam_engineer: Okay, checking webhook-processor: we added a guard last sprint to collapse "discount" and "invoice" adjustments into a single invoice-level discount for legacy flows. Looks like the experiment emits per-line discount items instead. Processor logic currently drops line.type=="discount".
sam_engineer: snippet from logs: `WARN 2026-03-21T08:12:45Z webhook-processor ignoring line id=dl_02 reason=type=discount not mapped`
maya: Do we have DLQ entries or only missed NetSuite postings?
billing-bot: nightly_recon job flagged 87 invoices missing promo lines, rule=BILLING_DISCOUNT_LINE_MISSING, uid=nr-20260321-12
anita: 4 customers already opened support tickets, 1 issued charge dispute. Financial exposure approx $6,750 USD.
kevin: Need immediate mitigation: 1) change processor to map discount lines to NS credit lines, 2) reprocess events + backfill NS, 3) notify affected customers and support. Approve auto-credit for systematic small-amount errors?
maya: Approve auto-credit for amounts < $500, and manual review for > $500. Any over that threshold we loop in finance ops.
sam_engineer: Will implement quick patch: `if line.type == "discount" and line.amount < 0: map_to_ns_credit(line)` and relax the previous collapsing rule. I'll push a short-lived feature flag so we can toggle if anything weird shows up.
sam_engineer: Deploy timeline: 20m to patch + canary, then replay DLQ: `webhook-processor replay --start 2026-03-21T00:00:00Z --end 2026-03-21T23:59:59Z --types discount`
sam_engineer: After replay, I'll run `ns-sync apply --mode backfill --confirm` in dry-run first. Expect full backfill to finish in ~40m.
anita: I'll prepare the credit memo batch template and the support playbook language (include apology and description of fix).
kevin: Also add a reconciliation assertion to nightly job: if Stripe has net_discount_total != NS.credit_total for the same invoices -> alert. Create an alerts-billing rule and tag on-call.
maya: Good. Add unit test to webhook-processor that verifies discount line -> NS credit mapping. Also add an integration test hitting staging NS mapping.
sam_engineer: Patch pushed to PR, starting canary now. Will report status here.
kevin: Thanks. Post once canary passes and after replay finishes. :thumbsup:
